translation.name: Romantic Move Seongsu Flagship Store
translation.summary: A Seongsu flagship store for a Korean shoe brand focused on craftsmanship and timeless footwear design.
translation.description: Romantic Move's Seongsu flagship reflects the neighborhood's continuing connection to handmade footwear. It is a useful stop for travelers who want to see a contemporary Korean shoe brand within Seongsu's traditional shoe-making district.
translation.local_tip: Combine this stop with Seongsu Handmade Shoe Street to compare the area's traditional and contemporary footwear culture.
